topic: Adding impression data to existing API
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on developing an API endpoint to include impression data alongside existing metrics. Initially, it was unclear if the requirement was for a separate API or an addition to the current system. [me] confirmed that adding impressions to the existing structure could be completed by the end of the week, but noted dependency on another team member (Свята). [p1] suggested confirming a delivery date of early next week. Despite initial concerns about timelines and ownership, [me] stated they would develop the feature over the weekend if necessary and plan to discuss it with the relevant person on Monday.

Later, there was a brief mention of an ongoing issue regarding frequency data.
decisions: The API will be updated to include impression metrics.
[me] committed to developing the impression addition by the end of the week or over the weekend if necessary.
action_items: [me] to discuss the implementation details with the relevant person on Monday.
